437:t_1:88.en:
$$宗介$$
「The $$サイデリアル$$ are coming, then...」

437:t_1:89.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Whatever comes, we will keep moving forward. No matter how difficult the road may be.」

437:t_1:90.en:
$$宗介$$
(I'm waiting for you, $n. For you to stand up again.)

437:t_1:91.en:
$$宗介$$
(The man I believe in can't be that weak.)

437:t_2:3.en:
$$タケル$$
「This cold, deep darkness that goes on forever... Is this $n's despair...?」

437:t_2:4.en:
$$タケル$$
「My brother's power inside me... Without that darkness, my mind might have been destroyed in an instant.」

437:t_2:5.en:
$$タケル$$
「The very bottom of it... Is the root of $n's despair here...?」

437:t_2:10.en:
$n
「No more...! I'll be good, so please, no more...」

437:t_2:11.en:
$$メグミ$$
「You're going to die with me! There's no point in living in a world like this!」

437:t_2:12.en:
$n
「N-no! I don't want to die! Mom, there's something wrong with you!!」

437:t_2:13.en:
$n
「I want to see Dad and Sis again, and live with Mom forever!」

437:t_2:14.en:
$$メグミ$$
「It's all right, $f. After I kill you, Mommy will die too.」

437:t_2:18.en:
$$メグミ$$
「See... this is what you get for thrashing around... Now your cute face has a cut on it.」

437:t_2:26.en:
$$タケル$$
「...$n was nearly killed by his own mother...」

437:t_2:29.en:
$n
(And then Mom... right in front of my eyes... took... her own life...)

437:t_2:30.en:
$$タケル$$
「That is the root of $n's despair...」

437:t_2:33.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Don't be swallowed by the past, $n! Your life is your own!!」

437:t_2:36.en:
$$カレン$$
「$n! Everyone came to bring you back!」

437:t_2:37.en:
$$シン$$
「Wake up! Don't let despair beat you!」

437:t_2:38.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「We've learned of the darkness inside you.」

437:t_2:39.en:
$$赤木$$
「If it gets hard, lean on us! We might not be able to do anything, but we can at least listen!」

437:t_2:40.en:
$$葵$$
「If we can make the despair you're carrying even a little lighter, we'll lend a hand!」

437:t_2:41.en:
$$甲児$$
「To keep your hope alive, we'll fight together with you!」

437:t_2:43.en:
$$バナージ$$
「We're comrades advancing into the future together!」

437:t_2:44.en:
$$シンジ$$
「I... might not be able to do anything, but I'll still fight with you!」

437:t_2:47.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「We've got Volunteer Club spirit, too!」

437:t_2:50.en:
$$万丈$$
「There must be a sun in your heart too!」

437:t_2:51.en:
$$シモン$$
「Blow that thing up! Like you always do!!」

437:t_2:52.en:
$$アムロ$$
「We've seen it happen time and again!」

437:t_2:53.en:
$$キラ$$
「So this time, too, we believe in you!」

437:t_2:54.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Get that heart of yours boiling!」

437:t_2:55.en:
$$桂$$
「If you're not alive, you can't enjoy the fun stuff or the happy stuff!」

437:t_2:58.en:
$$レド$$
「Are you going to quit halfway on the way of life you taught me!?」

437:t_2:59.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「That's right. Your journey is still only halfway.」

437:t_2:65.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Is it no use...!? Can we not save $n!?」

437:t_2:68.en:
$$クロウ$$
「You can still fight! You have to fight, right!?」

437:t_2:69.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「It's pointless. This guy's darkness is deeper than you can imagine.」

437:t_2:72.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「When he was little, his parents divorced, the mother who took him in nearly killed him, and he was left with wounds to his mind and body...」

437:t_2:73.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「At the home he was taken to, his father and sister lost their lives to an artificially induced $$時空震動$$...」

437:t_2:74.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「And now he's toyed with in the palm of the hand of the man who is his family's enemy, the woman he once loved is that man's subordinate, and the woman he loves is about to vanish...」

437:t_2:75.en:
$$アルト$$
「Miss $$スズネ$$ is going to vanish!?」

437:t_2:76.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「To be precise, she'll sink to the bottom of her consciousness and never be able to surface again.」
